next_step.text: move drupal/core to ^10.6.19 through drupal/admin_toolbar, drupal/core-recommended, drupal/lupus_ce_renderer and 4 more — clears left-behind and 62 advisories; 10.x needs php >=8.1.0; the target php 8.5 runs it; held by drunomics/service-utils 9.3.2 (requires 9.3.*; itself left-behind) and drupal/core-recommended 9.3.14 (requires 9.3.14; itself high: vulnerable) and drupal/ctools 3.7.0 (requires ^8.8 || ^9) and drupal/custom_elements 2.0.0-beta6 (requires ^8 || ^9) and drupal/entity_reference_revisions 1.9.0 (requires ^8.7.7 || ^9) and drupal/lupus_ce_renderer 2.0.0 (requires ^9) and drupal/metatag 1.19.0 (requires ^9) and drupal/paragraphs 1.14.0 (requires ^9.2; itself medium: vulnerable) and drupal/pathauto 1.10.0 (requires ^8.8 || ^9) and drupal/rest_menu_items 3.0.2 (requires ^8.8.4 || ^9) and drupal/token 1.10.0 (requires ^8.8 || ^9) and drupal/trusted_redirect 1.9.0 (requires ^8 || ^9); the packages that hold it may need to move too; a new major brings its own requirements, which lockrot does not solve
